title: HIV/AIDS Virology & CD4+ T-Cell Collapse
topic: Retrovirus Structure, Reverse Transcriptase, Macrophage Factory, & Opportunistic Infections
quickSummary: AIDS caused by Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV - diploid ssRNA retrovirus with Reverse Transcriptase). HIV gp120 binds CD4 receptors on Macrophages (which act as persistent HIV factories without dying) and CD4+ Helper T-cells. Lysis of TH cells leads to progressive collapse of CD4+ count (<200/μL), allowing fatal opportunistic infections (Mycobacterium, Toxoplasma, Pneumocystis). Diagnosed by ELISA & Western Blot.

conceptBreakdown.title: HIV Virology, Macrophage Factory, & Immunodeficiency Cascade

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: HIV is an enveloped retrovirus possessing 2 copies of ssRNA and Reverse Transcriptase. It infects CD4+ cells. Macrophages serve as an 'HIV Factory' producing virus continuously, while CD4+ Helper T-cells are lysed, causing progressive immune collapse (<200/μL) and opportunistic infections. Screening is by ELISA, confirmatory testing by Western Blot.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
HIV VIRION STRUCTURE & REPLICATION
                            
   Virion: Diploid ssRNA (2 x ssRNA) + Reverse Transcriptase, Integrase, Protease
           Envelope studded with gp120 and gp41 glycoproteins.
                            │
   Replication:
   gp120 binds CD4⁺ Receptor ──► Viral ssRNA converted to dsDNA via Reverse Transcriptase
   ──► Integrated into host genome via Integrase ──► Viral transcription & budding
   ├── Macrophages: Act as "HIV Factory" (produce virus continuously without dying)
   └── CD4⁺ T-Cells: Burst & deplete (<200/μL) ──► Severe Opportunistic Infections
conceptBreakdown.content:
### 8.1 Virion Architecture of HIV
- Enveloped, spherical **Retrovirus** with a diameter of $\approx 100\text{ nm}$.
- **Genetic Material**: **Two identical copies of single-stranded RNA ($2 \times \text{ssRNA}$)** (diploid genome).
- **Enzymatic Core**: Contains three key viral enzymes: **Reverse Transcriptase (RNA-dependent DNA polymerase)**, **Integrase**, and **Protease**.
- **Envelope Spikes**: Lipid bilayer envelope studded with **$gp120$** (docking glycoprotein) and **$gp41$** (transmembrane glycoprotein).

### 8.2 Pathogenesis & Progression to AIDS
1. **Cellular Entry**: Viral envelope spike $gp120$ binds high-affinity **$\text{CD4}$ receptors** and coreceptors (CCR5 / CXCR4) on host **Macrophages** and **$\text{CD4}^+$ Helper T-Cells ($T_H$)**.
2. **Reverse Transcription & Integration**: Inside host cytosol, viral Reverse Transcriptase synthesizes a complementary viral double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) from the viral ssRNA template. Viral Integrase incorporates this DNA into the host nuclear genome (provirus).
3. **Dual Host Cell Fate**:
   - **Macrophages ("HIV Factory")**: Continuously transcribe and produce new virions without being destroyed immediately.
   - **$\text{CD4}^+$ Helper T-Cells**: Virus replicates vigorously, lysing and destroying $T_H$ cells upon release.
4. **Immunological Collapse**: Over a latent period of $5\text{--}10\text{ years}$, circulating $\text{CD4}^+$ T-cell counts plummet from normal ($800\text{--}1200/\mu\text{L}$) to critical levels (**$<200/\mu\text{L}$**).
5. **Opportunistic Infections**: Characterized by recurrent bouts of fever, diarrhea, and severe weight loss with infections by *Mycobacterium avium*, *Pneumocystis jirovecii* pneumonia, *Toxoplasma gondii*, and fungal candidiasis.

### 8.3 Diagnostics & Antiretroviral Therapy (ART)
- **Diagnostic Protocol**: Screening via **ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay)**; confirmed by **Western Blot** (identifying specific viral proteins like $p24, gp120, gp41$).
- **Antiretroviral Drugs**: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors (**AZT / Zidovudine**) and protease inhibitors prolong patient lifespan but cannot eradicate the provirus from host reservoirs.

conceptBreakdown.title: Modes of Transmission & NACO Guidelines

summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: HIV transmits via sexual contact, contaminated blood, needle sharing, and transplacental/breastfeeding routes. It is NOT spread by casual social touch. NACO in India coordinates prevention campaigns.

conceptBreakdown.content: HIV is transmitted strictly through sexual intercourse with infected persons, transfusion of contaminated blood/blood products, sharing unsterilized intravenous needles, and vertical transmission from infected mother to fetus via placenta or colostrum; it is NOT spread by casual physical contact or vectors.

conceptBreakdown.heading: Elite Controllers and CCR5-delta32 Mutation
conceptBreakdown.title: Elite Controllers and CCR5-delta32 Mutation
conceptBreakdown.content: Individuals homozygous for the CCR5-delta32 deletion lack functional CCR5 coreceptors on their macrophage membranes, rendering them naturally resistant to HIV-1 infection.
